scope: local research preview only; operator explicitly said no YouTube

engine.finding: GPL concerns program distribution; generated output is not generally covered by the code license. This is separate from voice/data rights.

voice.finding: The CC BY link appears in the Dataset section; it is not an explicit blanket license for all model ancestry or output.

pretraining.finding: Original materials are covered by an individually granted research license with commercial-use restrictions. No matching written permission or exception for this model/output has been found.

publisher_clarification.author: Michael Hansen / synesthesiam
publisher_clarification.finding: Maintainer explicitly says Piper does not impose additional model/checkpoint licenses and leaves assessment of original licenses/training history to the end user. The repository MIT label therefore does not resolve this voice lineage.

conclusion: Evidence does not establish clearance for public release, including monetized YouTube. This is an operational clearance decision, not a court ruling that every possible output is infringing. Attribution alone does not resolve the Lessac lineage.
release_requirements: Use a voice with documented compatible model and training rights, or obtain written permission covering this voice lineage.
Keep the publication gate unapproved in this local request.
correction_to_previous_report: Previous shorthand describing the synthesized voice itself as CC BY 4.0 was too broad. CC BY is the documented VAIS1000 dataset license; new audio uses output-rights-unverified provenance.
